description: As a dispatcher, I want to submit a flight request form so that a new flight can be scheduled in the system.

acs.text: The Flight ID field validates that the value matches the format [A-Z]{2}[0-9]{4} (e.g. AA1234).
The Departure Date field must not accept a date in the past.
The Aircraft field must be selected from a dropdown of active aircraft only.
When all fields are valid, clicking Submit creates the flight request and returns the user to the flight list view.
